text.en: The AI Copilot is not a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser or Research Analyst and does not give investment advice. It explains the platform's rules, templates and data (backtests, market reads, risk settings) in plain words. Which strategy to run, with how much capital and whether to trade at all is your decision alone. Nothing it writes is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security, and past or simulated results do not predict future results. Paper trading first, then your own judgement.
